rule: Two-stage level feeling: the monster tier is shown on arrival; the object tier is held until a set number of squares are seen, then both are joined into one line. Town residents are drawn from a day or night count and placed a fixed distance from the arrival square. Shop greetings: half skip; otherwise a hint line with a one-in-three roll when hints exist. Town monsters are weak and give zero experience, so the first fight pays gold.
keep: Two-stage reveal: threat line on arrival, loot line after exploring a set number of squares
Harmless, zero-experience town residents as the first fight
Short one-line hints (under 80 characters) delivered by shopkeepers
Quickstart prompt for returning heroes (use as is, redo)
change: Our own feeling wording and tiers per zone, set server-side from zone data
No ASCII text screens; the threat line must read in two seconds at 375 wide
Death and respawn decided by row 17 and our ruling, not by the donor permadeath menu
Drop the change-history branch of quickstart unless our data holds a history
look_test: Build a 375-wide mock with no engine: an arrival card with a threat line, a second line that appears only after ten tiles are walked, a town square with four harmless residents at three tiles (gold-only drop, zero XP shown), and one hint line on the first shop visit. Compare with the current Pit intro: first hit under 10 seconds, threat named on one read, loot line felt as reward not delay.
